name: allan
description: Allan's workflow mods, built from his own session logs. Every feature has its own on/off row in /config and is switched with /mods on|off <feature>. ALLAN_MODS_OFF=1 disables all of them.

voice.title: voice: keep my reply style
voice.description: Adds Allan's reply rules to the system prompt so they survive compaction and new sessions. /style plain or /style visual changes the tone for this session.

voiceStyle.title: voice: default style
voiceStyle.description: normal: answer first, short, plain. plain: as if explaining to a high school student, crucial detail kept. visual: normal plus small ASCII diagrams where a flow or structure is involved.

commit.title: commit: commit and push hygiene
commit.description: Removes Claude attribution from commits and PRs, checks the push identity, and flags internal ids in client-facing text.

commitIdentity.title: commit: wrong push identity
commitIdentity.description: What to do when git push would go out through a remote that is not github.com-lua or with a user.email that is not the work address.

commitEmail.title: commit: work email
commitEmail.description: The user.email a push must carry.

commitInternalIds.title: commit: internal ids in client-facing text
commitInternalIds.description: What to do when a PR body or comment, or a file written under docs/ or Business_Documents/, carries internal memory references (D12, H22, Claude_Memory, HANDOFFS).

pulse.title: pulse: project band and /pending
pulse.description: A band above the prompt with this session's name, the project, the baton, parked items and handoffs addressed to you. /pending, /park and /unpark read and write INDEX.md.

pulseStaleDays.title: pulse: parked item counts as stale after (days)
pulseStaleDays.description: Parked items older than this turn the band yellow.

handover.title: handover: context meter, /handover and /close
handover.description: Shows ctx % in the status line with alerts at the thresholds, keeps lead sessions from auto compacting, and adds /handover <successor> and /close.

handoverThresholds.title: handover: alert at these context percentages
handoverThresholds.description: Comma separated; each alerts once per session. The last one says to hand over now.

handoverLeadPattern.title: handover: lead session names (regex)
handoverLeadPattern.description: Sessions whose name matches skip auto compaction and are told to hand over instead.

handoverBlockAutoCompact.title: handover: block auto compaction in lead sessions
handoverBlockAutoCompact.description: Off: lead sessions auto compact like any other. Manual /compact always works.

relay.title: relay: /sessions and /relay between sessions
relay.description: Records each session (name, project, folder) in a registry shared across your sessions, lists them with /sessions, sends text or the last START/END block with /relay, and shows relayed messages in the pulse band.
